title.narrative: Energy Community - Support to power, electricity and heat production

description.narrative: This project aims to scale up support to the energy sector in Ukraine. This will deliver results in electricity generation and heat production in Ukraine. The funds will be used for the purchase of one gas turbine as a first step. The recipient of the equipment will also ensure the construction of a so-called second-cycle for utilizing heat. The Energy Community Secretariat (EnCS) is suggested as the implementing partner for the procurement of the equipment, which will be part of the Ukraine Energy Support Fund (UESF). The project will help stabilize the energy supply in the Dnipro region, heavily affected by the war, by constructing a modern 125 MW Combined Heat and Power (CHP) plant to provide both electricity and heating to nearby areas. The gas turbine units are hydrogen-compatible (up to 75% H2 compatibility, with a roadmap for 100% by 2025), ensuring the plant’s future adaptability to renewable energy sources.
